summary: Executor Zygand in Brill coordinates the Forsaken campaign against the Scarlet Crusade in Tirisfal Glades. Using intelligence recovered by Executor Arren, you are dispatched to eliminate Scarlet Warriors stationed at a guard tower west of the Solliden Farmstead. This assault marks the Forsaken military's opening offensive to purge the zealous crusaders from their borders.

sections.title: A Two-Front War
sections.body: The fledgling Forsaken state under Lady Sylvanas Windrunner faces simultaneous threats on multiple fronts. While the Deathguard keeps a wary vigil against the swelling armies of the Lich King, the fanatical mortals of the Scarlet Crusade contest Forsaken dominance over their former homeland. The Crusade considers all undead abominations to be purged with fire and blade, blind to the fact that the Forsaken have broken free of the Scourge's control.

sections.title: Striking the Western Outpost
sections.body: Thanks to intelligence documents secured by Executor Arren at Deathknell, Executor Zygand now knows the exact encampments and outposts held by the zealots across Tirisfal Glades. With regular Deathguard garrisons occupied by Scourge containment, independent Forsaken champions are commissioned to strike out directly. The first strike falls upon the guard tower west of Solliden Farmstead, where Scarlet Warriors muster and threaten the western approaches to Brill.

faq.q: Why is the Scarlet Crusade hostile toward the Forsaken?
faq.answer: The Scarlet Crusade is an extremist human order dedicated to eradicating the undead. They make no distinction between the mindless Scourge controlled by the Lich King and the free-willed Forsaken loyal to Lady Sylvanas, viewing every undead being as a plague-ridden monster that must be burned.

Executor Zygand is the senior military officer of the Forsaken Deathguard stationed in Brill. He directs tactical deployments, defends the roads surrounding the capital's approaches, and oversees offensive strikes against nearby Scarlet and Scourge encroachments.

faq.q: How did the Forsaken get intelligence on Scarlet positions?
aliases: how did they find the tower
faq.answer: Crucial tactical documents were recovered by recruits serving Executor Arren in Deathknell. These papers laid out Scarlet patrol routes, outposts, and encampments throughout Tirisfal, giving Executor Zygand the information needed to orchestrate targeted counter-attacks.

faq.q: Where are the Scarlet Warriors located?
faq.answer: The Scarlet Warriors garrison a defensive tower located to the west of the Solliden Farmstead, in the western countryside of Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: Why doesn't the Deathguard handle the Crusade directly?
faq.answer: The Deathguard's formal ranks are stretched thin monitoring the Scourge, whose forces grow in number each night under the Lich King's reach. Because regular soldiers cannot be spared from containment, Zygand relies on ambitious, unassigned champions to cull the Crusaders.

faq.q: Does this mission end the Scarlet presence in Tirisfal?
aliases: is this the last scarlet quest
faq.answer: No. This attack on the western watchtower is merely the first strike in a four-part campaign directed by Executor Zygand to dismantle Scarlet command and outposts across the region.

angles.text: For the Forsaken, the Scarlet Crusade represents a bitter irony: living former countrymen who brand them monsters and seek their eradication rather than mourning the tragic fall of Lordaeron.
Establishing a secure border around Tirisfal Glades and the Undercity is essential to giving the Horde a permanent foothold in the Eastern Kingdoms.
